title: Alert value and load
question: Does an alert carry information, and would a daily user get a usable number of them?
headline: An alert is followed by a big move (top 20% of the asset's hours) 25% of the time for related assets vs 18% for unrelated ones (difference +7.5 points, CI +4.6 to +10.3). Reference portfolio: at least one alert on 55% of days, median 1/day, 95th percentile 8/day.
notes: Counts are a lower bound: only a sample of markets was collected (limitation L5).
Pass rule (pre-registered): big-move rate mapped − placebo CI > 0; >= 1 alert on >= 50% of days; 95th percentile <= 30 alerts/day.
